title: Google tests Gemini 3.2 Pro and Flash variants ahead of I/O
summary: Multiple Gemini 3.2 checkpoints (variants code-named Sprite and Cola) are being rapidly tested by Google through internal platforms ahead of Google I/O. Early outputs show solid SVG generation but front-end quality is described as less impressive than the prior Gemini 3 line.

research.notes: Pre-release internal testing leak. Public release expected around Google I/O (transcript suggests by May 22).
